summary.text: Norman Sanderson is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 2 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Roy Surrett.
He served in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013 and has been in the Senate since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Sanderson received a B.A. in Christian education from Logos University in 2002, according to Ballotpedia.

His professional experience includes work as a sheriff's deputy and a real estate business owner, and Ballotpedia says he has been a small business owner for over twenty years and owns Kids Heaven School Age Care Center.
Sanderson represented District 3 in the North Carolina House from 2011 to 2013 before joining the Senate in 2013.
The General Assembly's website lists his Senate district as covering Carteret, Chowan, Halifax, Hyde, Martin, Pamlico, Warren and Washington counties.

He chairs the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment Committee and the Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural, and Economic Resources Committee, and also serves on the Judiciary and Rules and Operations of the Senate committees, among others.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
